priority_rules.priority_1: Ground before the next flight and inspect when two or more independent indicators exceed alert thresholds or a current inspection identifies a safety-significant internal defect.
priority_rules.priority_2: Schedule prompt inspection before the stated remaining interval when one indicator approaches its threshold or a noncritical finding needs follow-up.
priority_rules.priority_3: Continue routine monitoring when sensor values are stable, inspection is current, and no alert threshold or defect finding is present.

evidence_rules: Compare vibration, exhaust-gas-temperature trend, oil debris, flight hours, maintenance status, and inspection findings for every engine.
Verify search results by exact _id and _source fields.
Departure period and monitoring cohort are descriptive fields, not causal engine-condition evidence.
